items.review_rationale: Read alternate bipartite graph definition via two-valued vertex coloring with every adjacent pair of vertices differently colored.

references.context: Each graph edge links vertices having distinct colors from a two-element codomain.

references.disposition: One of the two available color values need not be attained for an edgeless graph.

items.review_rationale: Read topological compactness as the open-cover finite-subcover property with no requirement of Hausdorff separation.

references.context: Family of open subsets whose union contains every point in X.
Finite subcollection of an open cover still covers X.

references.disposition: Compactness in this formulation does not include separation axioms.
